name: en-synthetic-01

training_quarantine.decision: owner ruling of 2026-10-15: quarantine the entire batch from training and adaptation, preserve every sample and digest, retain asr-domain-evaluation as its permitted use
training_quarantine.rule: identical, or one word set containing the other, or word-set Jaccard >= 0.8, or at least 5 leading words in common, after case folding and punctuation-to-space normalisation
training_quarantine.reason: 4 of the 8 kept clips repeat an English round-trip evaluation sentence from tools/evaluate.py: three by adding a clause, en_slot0_006.wav character for character. Training on this batch and then scoring it on that evaluation measures memorisation, not recognition.
training_quarantine.verification_limitation: the clip audio was never tracked (.gitignore excludes artifacts/**/*.wav) and is absent from this machine, so the 8 recorded SHA-256 values cannot be recomputed from files; this manifest is the only surviving record of them
release_requires: a batch forged by tools/corpus_forge.py from a training pool that reuses no sentence recorded here, whose manifest carries training_boundary with sentence_pools.collisions_found == 0
every clip digest recomputed from audio that exists on the machine doing the verifying
training_quarantine.evaluation_use: unaffected: asr-domain-evaluation remains permitted, including the read-only probe recorded at docs/audit-register.md A41 phase 1

licence_basis: Audio derived from an Apache-2.0 pretrained checkpoint (Kokoro-82M) selected for local inference; transcripts authored for this project. No scraped audio, no donor recordings, no third-party dataset. Redistribution of derived models must respect the checkpoint's Apache-2.0 attribution and the bundled espeak-ng GPL-3.0 data terms.
consent_basis: not applicable: no human speaker contributed a recording to this corpus

verifier.policy: clip kept only when round-trip WER <= 0.0
